body.statement: Uniformly over \(N/T\ge1\) and \(1\le m\le\delta T\), \(c_R\rho_{N,T,m}^2\le R^{\star}\le\liminf_{j\to\infty}\sup_{x\in\mathcal M_{T,m}}\mathbb E_x[(\widehat\theta_{r_{\mathrm{MSE},j}}-\ell(x))^2]\le C_R\rho_{N,T,m}^2\), where the constants depend only on \(\beta,\delta,c_q,C_q\). The oracle depth minimizes \(L(k/T)^{\beta}+Bk/(T-k)+\sigma\sqrt{T/N}/k\); its interior transition surfaces equate pairs of these three terms, and the terminal boundary phase is \(k^{\star}=m\). Mandatory homogeneous sanity check: if \(B=0\), \(m=o(k_0)\), and \(1\ll k_0\ll T\), where \(k_0=\{\sigma^2T^{2\beta+1}/(NL^2)\}^{1/(2\beta+2)}\), then both the nested envelope and its matched-date-block calibration have root-MSE order \(L^{1/(\beta+1)}\{\sigma^2/(NT)\}^{\beta/(2\beta+2)}\).
body.justification: The frontier prices smooth extrapolation, cohort composition, and the vanishing precision of late comparison dates in one causal target.
body.gap: Donoho gives the Gaussian shell and Borusyak, Jaravel, and Spiess diagnose missing long-run comparisons; neither computes this DiD exhaustion modulus or proves its bounded lift.
body.consumer: Event-study analyses obtain a principled comparison depth and a diagnosis of the binding smoothness, heterogeneity, or exhaustion component.
